scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: read agent's CSV and compare surface/edge-corner fractions to paper Table 4 values with tolerances and ordering checks. T1 recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the checker sandbox cannot re-run the full free-energy minimization, and the headline result is an aggregate table. The CSV format allows reliable extraction of the reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for surface and edge-corner fractions from paper Table 4
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 4: MD/MC-CEM model rows for Rh-Ni, Ni-Pd, Pd-Cu (50-50, 600 K)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published table; values match the reference solution.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper, traceable to Table 4.

outputs.description: Segregation fractions (surface and edge-corner) predicted by the free energy model for the three binary systems, both with and without size correction. The checker compares each value to the paper's reference within tolerances and verifies ordering.

output_contract.notes: The segregation results file must contain exactly 6 rows (3 systems × 2 model types). All values are floating-point numbers in the appropriate units.

steps.description: Compare surface_fraction and edge_corner_fraction to gold values with tolerances and verify ordering.
